import asyncio,json,time,statistics
import aiohttp

MODEL="qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M"
URL="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat"
PS="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps"

from open_webui.utils.session_pool import get_session, close_session, get_client_timeout
from open_webui.env import AIOHTTP_CLIENT_SESSION_SSL

def payload(ref):
    return {
        "model":MODEL,
        "messages":[{"role":"user","content":f"Reply with exactly OK. Ref {ref}."}],
        "stream":False,
        "options":{"num_ctx":4096,"num_predict":8,"temperature":0}
    }

def extract(route,ref,wall,body,status):
    rec={"route":route,"ref":ref,"status":status,"wall_ms":round(wall,3)}
    if isinstance(body,dict):
        for k in ("total_duration","load_duration","prompt_eval_duration","eval_duration","prompt_eval_count","eval_count"):
            if k in body:
                rec[k+"_ms" if k.endswith("_duration") else k]=round(body[k]/1e6,3) if k.endswith("_duration") else body[k]
        if "error" in body:
            rec["error"]=str(body["error"])[:200]
    return rec

async def do_direct(session,ref):
    data=json.dumps(payload(ref),separators=(",",":"))
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    async with session.post(URL,data=data,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=180)) as r:
        body=await r.json()
        status=r.status
    return extract("direct",ref,(time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,body,status)

async def do_owui(ref):
    session=await get_session()
    data=json.dumps(payload(ref),separators=(",",":"))
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    async with session.request(
        "POST",URL,data=data,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},
        ssl=AIOHTTP_CLIENT_SESSION_SSL,timeout=get_client_timeout(stream=False)
    ) as r:
        body=await r.json()
        status=r.status
    return extract("owui_session_pool",ref,(time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,body,status)

async def get_ps(session):
    async with session.get(PS,timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10)) as r:
        b=await r.json()
    return [{"name":m.get("name"),"context_length":m.get("context_length"),"expires_at":m.get("expires_at")} for m in b.get("models",[])]

async def main():
    print("BENCHMARK_SCHEMA=owui-session-pool-v1")
    print("LEDGER_SESSION=01a1001d-e1ee-7eb2-a6c4-91d7e19e1075")
    print("MODEL="+MODEL)
    print("SCOPE=direct_persistent_aiohttp_vs_openwebui_shared_session_pool")
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as direct_session:
        print("PS_BEFORE="+json.dumps(await get_ps(direct_session),separators=(",",":")))
        cold=await do_direct(direct_session,"cold")
        print("COLD="+json.dumps(cold,separators=(",",":")))
        for route,ref in (("owui","warmup-owui"),("direct","warmup-direct")):
            rec=await (do_owui(ref) if route=="owui" else do_direct(direct_session,ref))
            print("WARMUP="+json.dumps(rec,separators=(",",":")))
            if rec["status"]!=200: raise SystemExit(20)

        orders=[["direct","owui"],["owui","direct"]]*5
        records=[]; paired=[]
        for i,order in enumerate(orders,1):
            ref=str(3000+i); per={}
            for route in order:
                rec=await (do_direct(direct_session,ref) if route=="direct" else do_owui(ref))
                records.append(rec); per[route]=rec
                print("SAMPLE="+json.dumps(rec,separators=(",",":")))
                if rec["status"]!=200: raise SystemExit(21)
            paired.append(round(per["owui"]["wall_ms"]-per["direct"]["wall_ms"],3))

        summary={}
        for key in ("direct","owui_session_pool"):
            vals=[r["wall_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==key]
            srv=[r["total_duration_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==key and "total_duration_ms" in r]
            net=[r["wall_ms"]-r["total_duration_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==key and "total_duration_ms" in r]
            summary[key]={
                "n":len(vals),"min_ms":round(min(vals),3),
                "median_ms":round(statistics.median(vals),3),
                "mean_ms":round(statistics.fmean(vals),3),
                "max_ms":round(max(vals),3),
                "ollama_total_median_ms":round(statistics.median(srv),3),
                "client_delta_median_ms":round(statistics.median(net),3)
            }
        summary["paired_owui_minus_direct_ms"]={
            "median":round(statistics.median(paired),3),
            "mean":round(statistics.fmean(paired),3),
            "min":round(min(paired),3),"max":round(max(paired),3),
            "samples":paired
        }
        print("SUMMARY="+json.dumps(summary,separators=(",",":")))
        print("PS_AFTER="+json.dumps(await get_ps(direct_session),separators=(",",":")))
    await close_session()

asyncio.run(main())
PY
